stem: A pharmacist discovers that the wrong warfarin strength was dispensed, but the patient reports no injury and the event does not meet the separate serious-event reporting threshold. The manager says, ‘Then we do not need to document anything.’ What is the best response under 247 CMR 15.03?

choices.text: The absence of a serious-injury report does not eliminate the separate requirement to initially document the QRE within 24 hours of discovery or notification.
The manager is correct because QRE documentation exists only for events that cause serious injury or death.
The event should be documented only at the next annual CQI education session.
The pharmacy must wait seven business days before creating any internal QRE record.
Only the patient, rather than the pharmacy, may create documentation when no injury occurred.

explanation.core_reasoning: QRE documentation and Board serious-event reporting are different duties with different triggers. A dispensing error can require the pharmacist’s initial QRE documentation even when it does not meet the serious-injury or death threshold for a separate report under 247 CMR 20.

choice_analysis.A: The pharmacist’s initial QRE record is tied to discovery or notification of the event, not to the separate serious-event threshold.
choice_analysis.B: Serious injury is relevant to a different reporting pathway; it is not the definition of every QRE that must be documented.
choice_analysis.C: Annual education is not a substitute for event-specific initial documentation.
choice_analysis.D: A seven-business-day reporting clock belongs to a different regulatory duty and should not delay the QRE record.
choice_analysis.E: The pharmacy has its own documentation obligation regardless of whether the patient creates a record.

related_facts: One event can trigger CQI duties without triggering Board serious-event reporting.
Warfarin errors can be clinically important even when no serious injury has yet occurred.
explanation.mpje_trap: Do not use the absence of one reporting trigger to erase a different documentation duty.

reasoning_steps: Determine that the dispensing error is a QRE requiring internal documentation
Determine separately that the serious-event reporting threshold is not met
Apply the QRE clock independently of the reporting outcome
